name: onboarding-webapp

dependencies.name: onboarding-api
dependencies.description: Calls the onboarding API for new hires, the checklist template, and department task queues.

description: Staff-facing single-page app for HR, IT and Facilities. HR adds new hires, maintains the checklist template, adds one-off tasks, and sees overdue items and cross-department status; IT and Facilities each work their own task queue. Holds no business data of its own — everything comes from onboarding-api.
